experiment.description: Nine previously captured game images; one/two/three questions on each exact image. Lane prompt, state text, model and resolution fixed; order rotated. Small teaching comparison, not a general accuracy benchmark.

state.text: Top-down three-lane road. The cream car at the bottom is YOU. Orange striped blocks form a barrier with one open lane. Find the opening from the image. No game coordinates are provided.

lane.instructions: Which of the three road lanes has NO orange striped obstacle? Look at the row of orange blocks. Choose the gap, ignoring where the cream car is.

criteria.left: The LEFT lane is the gap in the orange barrier.
criteria.middle: The MIDDLE lane is the gap in the orange barrier.
criteria.right: The RIGHT lane is the gap in the orange barrier.
